'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Matt Lush LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Lush]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|VB4-L-angerfearaggression-pre.gif|label=Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
